summary.zh: 手动跑一轮：改一处、评测、留或弃
summary.en: Run one manual iteration: edit, evaluate, keep or discard.

description.zh: 手动执行一轮实验：看过往记录后确定一处改动，提交并评测，再按结果保留或丢弃。适合想逐步观察、不交给定时循环的时候使用。需要实验已经配置好评测命令。
description.en: Runs exactly one experiment iteration: review history, settle on a single change, commit, evaluate, then keep or discard. Use it to watch progress step by step instead of scheduling a loop. An eval command must already be configured.
